MWI.note: Only a paper tender-box submission and a procurement act are mentioned; no e-procurement system is stated.
The notice is the revenue authority's; nothing on the central bank.
Off-channel remittance fraud detection is an aim only; no corridor is stated.
Operators' data centres are mentioned only as sites for on-premises running; nothing on hire.
Nothing on government payments to people.
ISO certificates are required of bidders only; that places nothing.
Nothing on nationally owned data centres for hire.
No survey share of adults with an account is given.
Nothing on the national standards body.

facts.fact: The Malawi Revenue Authority says mobile money has become one of the largest and fastest-growing channels of financial activity in Malawi, with annual transaction values of about MWK 40 trillion.

systems.system: Independent Mobile Money and Telecommunications Revenue Monitoring System

MWI.note: The notice seeks a system to monitor operators' declarations of levies; it states no electronic payment of taxes.
